sourceBackedClaims.claim: A restrictive tool allowlist retains the MCP meta-tools search_tool and use_tool.
TodoWrite and otherwise unmatched tool inputs map to Read access; UseTool maps to MCPTool access.
Bare Read and MCPTool names parse as tool-wide permission rules, while an unrecognized bare star falls through to an Any rule with a star pattern.
A policy deny is evaluated before the YOLO fast path.
streaming-messages-json emits an init line, message frames, a terminal result, tool-use blocks, stop reason, and structured_output.

The official Claude Code bridge demonstrates shell-free argv spawning and structured output, but its review path uses always-approve with a read-only sandbox and does not supply the adapter's hard process-tree timeout contract.
